annotations.title: Calculate INSS, IRRF, net salary and employer FGTS for one salary

description: Calculates the monthly payroll deductions of one Brazilian salary or pro-labore under the 2025-2026 tables: progressive employee INSS up to the ceiling, IRRF choosing automatically whichever of the legal deductions or the BRL 607.20 simplified discount is cheaper, the resulting net salary and the employer's 8% FGTS deposit. Use it to show an employee or candidate their take-home pay, to compare CLT with pro-labore, or to check a payslip. Do not use it for 13th salary, vacation pay, termination amounts, overtime or benefits, which are not modelled, or for the employer's own 20% INSS and third-party charges, which are not returned. Read 'payrollCalc'. Costs 0.008 USDC per call, paid with x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or with a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header instead of an exception, and every failure is a JSON body with 'error', so an agent loop never breaks on a thrown error. Deterministic arithmetic at the edge: nothing is stored or filed, no government system is contacted, and the same input always gives the same numbers. Results are estimates for planning and reconciliation, not a substitute for an accountant's sign-off.

aiSummary.description: When true (the default) the response carries 'aiExecutiveBrief', one Portuguese sentence of at most 35 words with the key amounts, written by an edge model with a deterministic fallback. Set false to skip it when you only need the numbers.

dependents.description: Number of IRRF dependents; each deducts BRL 189.59 from the tax base.

grossSalary.description: Monthly gross salary or pro-labore, in BRL, for example 6500.

isProLabore.description: True for a partner's pro-labore: INSS becomes a flat 11% capped at the ceiling and no FGTS is due.

otherDeductions.description: Other legal monthly deductions in BRL, such as court-ordered alimony.

name: calculate_payroll_net_salary

outputSchema.description: Single JSON document. All three tools of this server share one paid call and return the same envelope; each fills the block named in its description.

aiExecutiveBrief.description: One Portuguese sentence with the key amounts, present unless aiSummary is false.

error.description: Portuguese failure reason, present only on a rejected call, such as an invalid JSON body (HTTP 400).

payrollCalc.description: Monthly payroll deductions under the 2025-2026 INSS and IRRF tables. Amounts in BRL rounded to cents.

fgtsEmployerCost.description: Employer FGTS deposit at 8% of gross, 0 for pro-labore. Not deducted from the employee.

inssDiscount.description: Employee INSS: progressive brackets up to the BRL 8,157.41 ceiling, or 11% for pro-labore.

inssEffectiveRatePct.description: INSS as a percentage of gross salary.

irrfBase.description: IRRF taxable base after the chosen deduction.

irrfMethodUsed.description: Whichever of the BRL 607.20 simplified discount or the legal deductions (INSS + BRL 189.59 per dependent + other deductions) gives the lower tax.

isProLabore.description: Whether the partner pro-labore rule was applied (flat 11% INSS, no FGTS).

netSalary.description: Gross minus INSS minus IRRF; other payroll items such as benefits are not included.

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, also in the X-Processing-Time-Ms header.

suggestedNextSteps.description: Chaining hints for autonomous agents: sibling paid APIs commonly called next, such as a CNPJ check of the Simples Nacional status. Purely advisory.

endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint of the follow-up API.

priceUsdc.description: Price of the follow-up call in USDC.

tool.description: Tool name of the suggested follow-up API.

when.description: Condition under which the follow-up is worth making.
